before.name: HaMotzi
before.when: Bread, pita, challah, bagels, rolls. Wash hands first (Netilat Yadayim). Covers the whole meal.
before.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמּוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן הָאָרֶץ:
before.tr: Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech ha'olam, hamotzi lechem min ha'aretz.
before.en: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who brings forth bread from the earth.

before.name: Mezonot
before.when: Cake, cookies, crackers, pasta, couscous, oatmeal, rice. Anything from the five grains that is not bread.
before.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא מִינֵי מְזוֹנוֹת:
before.tr: Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech ha'olam, borei minei mezonot.
before.en: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates kinds of nourishment.

before.name: HaGefen
before.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הַגֶּֽפֶן:
before.tr: Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech ha'olam, borei peri hagefen.
before.en: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the fruit of the vine.

before.name: HaEtz
before.when: Fruit that grows on trees: apples, oranges, dates, grapes, olives, almonds, avocado.
before.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָעֵץ:
before.tr: Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech ha'olam, borei peri ha'etz.
before.en: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the fruit of the tree.

before.name: HaAdamah
before.when: Vegetables, potatoes, bananas, strawberries, melon, peanuts, corn, legumes.
before.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה:
before.tr: Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech ha'olam, borei peri ha'adamah.
before.en: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the fruit of the ground.

before.name: Shehakol
before.when: Water, coffee, tea, juice, milk, meat, chicken, fish, eggs, cheese, chocolate, candy, mushrooms.
before.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהַכֹּל נִהְיָה בִּדְבָרוֹ:
before.tr: Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech ha'olam, shehakol nihyah bidvaro.
before.en: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, by whose word everything came to be.

after.name: Borei Nefashot
after.when: After a kezayit (about 27 g) of fruit, vegetables, meat, dairy, sweets, or a reviit (about 86 ml) of any drink except wine.
after.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה, אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא נְפָשׁוֹת רַבּוֹת וְחֶסְרוֹנָן עַל כָּל־מַה־שֶּׁבָּרָֽאתָ לְהַחֲיוֹת בָּהֶם נֶֽפֶשׁ כָּל־חָי, בָּרוּךְ חַי הָעוֹלָמִים.
after.tr: Baruch Atah Adonai, Eloheinu Melech ha'olam, borei nefashot rabot vechesronan, al kol mah shebarata lehachayot bahem nefesh kol chai. Baruch chei ha'olamim.
after.en: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates many souls and their needs, for all that You created to sustain every living being. Blessed is the Life of the worlds.

after.name: Al HaMichya
after.short: After cake, pasta, rice and other Mezonot
after.when: After a kezayit of grain food. Rice is the exception: after rice say Borei Nefashot.

after.name: Al HaGefen
after.when: After a reviit of wine or grape juice. Same text as Al HaMichya, with the words for the vine.

after.name: Al HaEtz
after.when: After grapes, figs, pomegranates, olives or dates. Same text as Al HaMichya, with the words for fruit.

after.name: Birkat HaMazon
after.when: After eating a kezayit of bread. The full grace after meals.

foods.name: Matzah (outside Pesach)
foods.note: Sephardic practice: Mezonot outside Pesach unless it is your meal. On Pesach: HaMotzi.

foods.name: Cake, cookies, muffins
foods.note: If you eat a meal's worth (about 230 g), wash and say HaMotzi.

foods.name: Pizza
foods.note: Sephardic practice: Mezonot for a slice or two; a full meal of it is HaMotzi.

foods.name: Rice (cooked)
foods.note: Mezonot before, but Borei Nefashot after, not Al HaMichya.

foods.name: Grapes, raisins
foods.note: One of the seven species: Al HaEtz after a kezayit.

foods.name: Dates, figs, pomegranate, olives
foods.note: Seven species: Al HaEtz after a kezayit.

foods.name: Banana
foods.note: The banana plant is not a tree in halachah.

foods.name: Potato (boiled, baked, fries, chips)
foods.note: Mashed potato is also HaAdamah in Sephardic practice.

foods.name: Water, soda, sparkling water
foods.note: Borei Nefashot only after a reviit (about 86 ml) drunk normally.

foods.name: Coffee, tea
foods.note: Usually sipped slowly, so no after-blessing.

foods.name: Soup (clear broth)
foods.note: Thick vegetable soup follows the vegetables: HaAdamah. Noodle soup: Mezonot.

foods.name: Sushi
foods.note: Rice is the main part: Mezonot before, Borei Nefashot after. Ask about the fish if it is the main part.
